Method of Attack: Use of zero-day exploits targeting Chrome and Android OS to install spyware implants
Installation of Android Alien banking trojan with RAT functionality to load Predator implant
Attack Vector: One-time links mimicking URL shortener services sent via email
Redirect to attacker-owned domains delivering exploits
Indicators of Compromise: Exploited zero-day vulnerabilities: CVE-2021-37973, CVE-2021-37976, CVE-2021-38000, CVE-2021-38003 in Chrome; CVE-2021-1048 in Android
Infection observed in targets from Egypt, Armenia, Greece, Madagascar, Côte d'Ivoire, Serbia, Spain, Indonesia
